turns.user: The exported HTML shows 'Loading widget...' instead of the sliders. Why?

turns.assistant: nbconvert only embeds widget views if the notebook metadata has a widgets state entry. The notebook must be saved with Save Widget State on, or the kernel run must call ipywidgets.embed or nbclient with store_widget_state. Without it every widget renders as the placeholder, no error is raised.
